title: Random
description: KRM transformer that generates a random string or number and writes it into matched target fields. When keepers are configured, the output is deterministically seeded by the keeper field values — like Terraform's random_string keepers attribute.

apiVersion.description: API version for the Random resource

config.kubernetes.io/function.description: Kustomize function annotation (should be: exec:\n  path: kubectl-kubed)

length.description: Length of the generated string (type: string only)

lower.description: Include lowercase letters in the pool (type: string only)

upper.description: Include uppercase letters in the pool (type: string only)

numeric.description: Include digits in the pool (type: string only)

special.description: Include special characters in the pool (type: string only)

override_special.description: Custom special-character pool used when special is true (type: string only)

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for the random integer (type: number only)

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for the random integer (type: number only)

keepers.description: Resource selectors whose values seed the RNG. When set, the generated value is deterministic across runs — same keeper values produce the same output. Omit to get a fresh random value every run. Path resolution is a fallback chain per matched resource: (1) the keeper's own fieldPaths if any, otherwise (2) the resource's own 'random.krm.kubed.io/keepers.fieldpaths' annotation (newline-separated paths), otherwise (3) the entire resource (metadata.annotations stripped so annotation churn doesn't re-roll). Values can be scalars, nested objects, or large strings — all canonicalized before going into the seed.

targets.description: Target selectors that receive the generated value at the given fieldPath.

options.description: Optional patch options. When delimiter is set, the existing field value is split on it and the slot at index is replaced — useful for stamping the token into one part of a name like my-job-<random>.

delimiter.description: Character to split the existing field value on

index.description: Index within the split array to replace with the random value

apiVersion.description: Regex matched against the resource apiVersion

kind.description: Regex matched against the resource kind

matchLabels.description: Label selector — all entries must match

matchAnnotations.description: Annotation selector — all entries must match

fieldPaths.description: Optional list of JSON-pointer paths within the matched resource. Omit or leave empty to use the entire resource (with annotations stripped). Each entry's value may be a scalar, an object, or a large string; values are appended to the seed in declared order.

fieldPath.description: JSON-pointer path within the matched resource where the random value is written (e.g. /metadata/name).
